9. Feeding cup

A white porcelain cup, with a long pouring spout and small handle. The top of the cup is half- enclosed on the spout side to enable the vessel to be tilted. There is a gold decorative line applied to the top of the vessel, outlining the rim. A gold line also runs down the side of the spout to the point at which it meets the cup wall, and a gold line is also observed on the vessel’s handle. The faded nature of this line may indicate frequent use of this object.
